title: Crossed products realize every continuous units class
statement: For every field K and every x in its continuous degree-two separable-closure units cohomology [def-sc-galois-units-cohomology], there exists a finite-dimensional central simple K-algebra A with R(A,x), where R is the matrix scalar-defect relation [def-sc-brauer-scalar-defect].
